entries.subject: Placement

(2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 182572: the Hipparcos parallax the radius was computed with (van Leeuwen 2007), 65.89 +/- 0.26 mas, inverted (https://doi.org/10.1088/0004-637X/746/1/101): 15.177 +/- 0.06 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 67.0153 +/- 0.0657 mas (same row, RUWE 0.72), 1020.7 standard errors, is not used. Mass 1.186 +/- 0.015 solar masses from Boyajian et al. entries.subject: Colour

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,787 K and log g 4.23 (u1 0.454, u2 0.263): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
